query:
SELECT
            (
                SELECT preco_kg::float8
                FROM precos_mercado
                WHERE regiao = $1
                  AND data <= $2
                ORDER BY data DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS "preco_hoje?",
            (
                SELECT preco_kg::float8
                FROM precos_mercado
                WHERE regiao = $1
                  AND data <= $2
                ORDER BY data DESC
                LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
            ) AS "preco_7d_atras?"
